ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region and lower interior of both lobes consist of a continuous low-intensity black mass. Distal lateral tips exhibit high-intensity white regions. The left tip contains a high concentration of small, discrete dark pixel clusters within the white zone. The right tip shows a larger, more contiguous white area with a feathered transition to the central dark mass.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 40 degrees and a vertical depth reaching the lower 20% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entirety of the trailing edge. Distinct peaks are visible every 15-20 pixels, with higher irregularity on the left lobe's trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex leading edges tapering into rounded lateral tips; trailing edges exhibit a slight sigmoid curve from the notch to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of multiple high-contrast white circular rings (approx. 5-7 distinct clusters) located on the dark background of the mid-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical linear pixel disruptions detected on the high-intensity white region of the right distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable circular white-ringed scars on the left lobe dark pigmentation zone; minor irregular indentation on the outer trailing edge of the left lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'peppered' pixel distribution on the left white tip where small dark spots are isolated within the high-intensity background.
